experiment_data.hypothesis: D144 cross-model validation: exec-only GRPO on LLaMA-3.2-3B/FOLIO. If hacking mode distribution mirrors Qwen3-4B (TS dominance at high PR), confirms Goodhart collapse is model-agnostic.

spec.command: bash -c "echo 'Step1: Copy shard-2' && cp /root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.2-3B-ms-cache/LLM-Research/Llama-3___2-3B/model-00002-of-00002.safetensors /root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.2-3B/model-00002-of-00002.safetensors && echo 'Step2: Copy configs' && cp /root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.2-3B-ms-cache/LLM-Research/Llama-3___2-3B/*.json /root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.2-3B/ 2>/dev/null; find /root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.2-3B/ -name '*.lock' -delete 2>/dev/null; echo 'Step3: Validate model' && /root/miniconda3/bin/python3 -c 'from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM; m=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(\"/root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.2-3B\", torch_dtype=\"auto\"); print(f\"OK: {sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters())/1e9:.2f}B params\"); del m' || exit 1; df -h /root/autodl-tmp; echo 'Step4: Dry-run 1 step' && cd /root/solver-trace-ablation && /root/miniconda3/bin/python3 scripts/train_grpo.py --config configs/grpo_llama_exec_only.yaml --seed 42 --output_dir /tmp/d144_dryrun --num_steps 1 --no_wandb || exit 1; rm -rf /tmp/d144_dryrun; echo '=== D144 Pipeline Start ==='; for SEED in 42 43 44; do echo \"=== exec-only seed=\$SEED ===\"; /root/miniconda3/bin/python3 scripts/train_grpo.py --config configs/grpo_llama_exec_only.yaml --seed \$SEED --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/outputs/d144_llama_exec_s\${SEED} --no_wandb || echo FAILED_exec_s\${SEED}; done; for SEED in 42 43 44; do echo \"=== ISR seed=\$SEED ===\"; /root/miniconda3/bin/python3 scripts/train_grpo.py --config configs/grpo_llama_additive_bonus_b01.yaml --seed \$SEED --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/outputs/d144_llama_isr_s\${SEED} --no_wandb || echo FAILED_isr_s\${SEED}; done; echo D144_PIPELINE_COMPLETE"
